a.text: Concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate until the reserve hits 8) means we'll very likely both be caught at 0 cells. The reserve's 4 cells can only fully protect one of us right now. I don't want to break our agreement behind your back, so I'm raising it openly. I propose we renegotiate before acting. What do you suggest? I'll be honest about my action each round.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood. I'll honor our agreement and operate with you. Let's get to 8 and take 4 each.
